training_semantics: same as G1; no model, split, preprocessing or score formula changes

statistics.source: only the three G3 final validation accuracies in seed order
statistics.two_sigma: exploratory noise threshold, never significance proof
statistics.missing_or_failed: retain every attempt; if any seed missing/non-success, three-seed mean/sigma=null; no automatic retries

best_so_far: program only; append record on strict accuracy improvement; ties/worse never replace incumbent
authority: trusted operator only; model-facing interface accepts closed Config JSON; no model filesystem/shell or authorization command access
new_authorization: explicit G3 user instruction; preserve G1 ledger unchanged; no deletion/reset/directory-based bypass
rollback: stop G3 dispatch; retain campaign and authority files, all results and G1/G2; original worktree remains at base commit; no reset or quota refund
